claims.text: Collagenase or other enzymes for mild fibrotic or necrotic tissue, when caretakers aren't trained in mechanical debridement, or for patients who can't tolerate surgery; most effective after careful cross-hatching of the wound with a scalpel
claims.quote: This technique (using collagenase, papain, fibrinolysin, deoxyribonuclease, or streptokinase/streptodornase) can be used for patients with mild fibrotic or necrotic tissue within the ulcer. It can also be used for patients whose caretakers are not trained to perform mechanical debridement or for patients unable to tolerate surgery. It is most effective after careful and judicious cross-hatching of the wound with a scalpel to improve penetration.
